qs.s: Le ___ du projet a été marqué par quelques difficultés.
qs.en: The beginning of the project was marked by a few difficulties.

qs.en: They celebrated the beginning of the new year with enthusiasm.

qs.s: Au ___, personne ne croyait en son talent.
qs.en: At first, no one believed in his talent.

qs.s: Au ___, les deux équipes étaient à égalité.
qs.en: At first, the two teams were tied.

qs.en: From the very opening of the novel, the author establishes a mysterious atmosphere.

qs.en: This speech marks the opening of a new era for our country.

qs.en: They say that every beginning is always difficult.

qs.en: It is a promising beginning for this startup.

qs.en: The company announced a collective redundancy plan affecting three hundred employees.

qs.en: Faced with the economic crisis, mass layoffs were carried out in the automotive sector.

qs.en: The board of directors voted for the removal from office of the CEO for serious misconduct.

qs.en: The Federal Chancellor of Germany presented his government programme yesterday.

qs.en: The chancellor of the university inaugurated the new library in the presence of the professors.

qs.s: Il a été élu ___ de l'université après vingt ans de carrière académique.
qs.en: He was elected chancellor of the university after twenty years of academic career.

qs.en: He is the most influential chancellor of this decade.

qs.en: My father greatly admires the chancellor who has been leading this university for ten years.
